Grand Entrance
20 Energy
Instant45 sec cooldown
Leap into the air, becoming immune to crowd control effects, and then crash back down with incredible speed at your enemy.

Upon landing, deal 400% Weapon Damage to enemies in the impact area, plus an additional (6*1000/2)*(203+1.8 Points Per Level+AP*0.2575) over 6 sec, ignoring Armor and knocking them into the air.
